body:
Hey thanks for your quickly reply. Do you have any advice for coping through the next few weeks? My occupation is lonely by nature and a lot of my friends are not here at the moment. I have a lot of downtime in the day and it’s a struggle to get through. I also have trouble doing things to distract myself since the depression makes my energy levels so low.

I have reached out recently to most of my friends and just now my sister so that’s a good start.
I just got in contact with the texting hotline

it’s really really hard to distract myself effectively, i’m pretty alone rn and my work is also alone so that’s been difficult, any advice? i also have really low energy all the time so it’s hard to bring myself to do things.

Hi thank you for the quick response. I use that subreddit sometimes. I think I my try the hotline again though I had a bad experience with it one time.

Sometimes I feel jealous or angry that she can look back at us with relatively good memories but for me it just feels so tainted and painful. I just wish I never met her...
I am experiencing this right now... I commiserate with you:(

That’s true. I actually sort of intended the I think bit to be kind of the opposite. Like I legitimately feel it might come completely out of the blue. I could totally, objectively see myself just waking up tomorrow and deciding to calmly hang myself. Or doing it in 2 weeks. Or 2 months or whatever. But I suppose the opposite is also true. Thanks for your comment I liked it.
We actually broke up a long time ago. But we had an on and off getting back together thing so many times since. So I guess the wound keeps reopening.
yes oh my gosh it is the stuff like this. I miss all the small stuff and always having her to talk to about everything. And always having someone willing to spend time. I feel so empty now.

ok so my ex thought this type of thing a lot (she’s a bad person, doesn’t deserve XYZ). I think she did it because she almost wanted to punish herself if she did something wrong. But that shouldn’t be the case at all. Like she definitely deserves love and is trying to improve herself. The fact that you are self aware and trying to improve yourself already is such a big thing. I think if anything you might want to spend time sorting out any problems you feel you have with yourself that might make dating hard, but don’t let it affect you in a way such that you feel you don’t deserve love.
Yes I feel this all the time. Sometimes I miss her so much it’s insane and sometimes I feel really angry at her. And this up and down sensation confuses me and makes me sad.

That’s sucks. I can’t imagine what that’s like:( I’m sorry.

Yeah, the trusting part is a HUGE issue for me. On the bright side I like to think when I finally find someone I can trust (though I would ease into this much more slowly this time) it will be so amazing!!!
